hostDifferences.difference: Memory is available when this machine's memory (Settings > Memory: chat-memory enabled and not paused) is on; no claude.ai account memory status.
The memory ({memory, controls, updated_at}) is the local one (<userData>/memory, chat-memory state, the account or a project's) instead of /api/organizations/<org>/memory.
"Add text content" adds a text knowledge file through main (local-projects knowledge-add-text over project-knowledge.mjs addKnowledgeText) instead of the claude.ai project docs endpoint.
The project record _r reads is the local project: always private (a local project is never shared).
An edit (controls) is saved and the memory regenerated by chat-memory (op controls: the core writes it in a hidden thread) instead of the claude.ai memory endpoints; no success toast.

No MCP resource sources: Sr lists them only behind GrowthBook nebula_drift_enabled (off without GrowthBook, E49) and only for remote connectors with a url, read through claude.ai's in-browser MCP clients and kept as a claude.ai sync source; this machine's connectors run in the core (stdio), so the rows are not offered (closeout chatfn-projects-11).

GitHub is not offered as a knowledge source: its sync needs the claude.ai GitHub integration (OAuth through claude.ai, the org integrations query QA), which a local project has no account for — the branch the official takes when the integration is not enabled (E63 chatfn-projects-11).
No GitHub authentication (claude.ai OAuth): the GitHub row is never shown, so its click (check, then auth) never runs.
No claude.ai remote MCP clients: the server list Sr reads for MCP resource sources is empty.
The knowledge size is the local store's token estimate (project-knowledge.mjs statsOf tokens) instead of /kb/stats.
maxKbTokens is the local MAX_KB_TOKENS (project-knowledge.mjs, Claude's context window) instead of the model list's hard_limit or a GrowthBook value.

The project knowledge search UI rollout (GrowthBook claude_ai_project_bananagrams) is off without GrowthBook (E49): the capacity bar shows its Info "Learn more about project knowledge" button and no Search mode label or threshold mark. The local search itself (project_knowledge_search past INLINE_MAX_CHARS) still runs; turning the label on is this adapter returning true.
No claude.ai project settings: the search threshold mark is not drawn (the rollout is off).
The "Search mode" label reads the rollout first (off), as the official does; the local store's searchMode is not shown.

Files picked in the hidden input are read in the renderer as { name, bytes } and added by main (local-projects knowledge-add-content: private copies, conversion, size / count / capacity refusals) instead of the claude.ai upload; no pending tiles or encoding picker.
The GitHub sync modal (lazy c23f22bfb) is not loaded: the GitHub row is never shown.
No claude.ai in-app routes: a tile's url never resolves to one (null), and a local knowledge file's tile has no url (it opens nothing, as mD does with no handleClick and no url).

The memory text is drawn by the host SourceChatMarkdown (src/source-chat-markdown.jsx), which renders c89efce1a rc itself as w13-close-chat-renderer sliced it (src/generated/chat-renderer, ChatTextMarkdown: cc1aae219 OR → rc); this graph does not slice rc a second time (D1).
